system.notes: Low-heat, high-thrust engines give flight at up to 300 kph with a range of about 500 kilometres. It weighs 25 kg and is worn on a harness. The space-capable version is called a thruster: its practical maximum is 1,000 kph, which spends exactly half the fuel - the other half stops it again at the far end.
